name: hacklcx/HFish
description: HFish is a free, community-driven enterprise honeypot system built in Go supporting 90+ service types for threat detection across internal networks and external perimeters. It uses a B/S architecture for centralized management of distributed honeypot nodes.
score_rationale: Feature-rich enterprise honeypot with 4.5k stars and broad protocol support, particularly popular in Asian enterprise environments.
